name: The Inner Sanctum
subtitle: Deeper into darkness, closer to truth
location: Valdris's Inner Sanctum and Core Chamber

scenes.narration: The deeper passages of the fortress are not halls — they are arteries. The stone pulses with something that might be blood, might be power. The air tastes of fear and ancient memory. The first four push ahead — Ria, Valka, Rex, Drake — cutting the path while the others hold the outer wall against the Citadel's remaining defenders.
Valka walks ahead, her sword blazing with divine light. The darkness recoils from her presence.

dialogue.speaker: Valka
dialogue.text: I have walked between worlds for millennia. I have never felt a darkness like this. It is not evil — it is grief. Infinite, absolute, all-consuming grief.

dialogue.speaker: Rex
dialogue.text: A being that became everything it feared. That is a tragedy I understand all too well.

dialogue.speaker: Ria
dialogue.text: The eidolons weep. They sense what he was — and what he refused to be.

dialogue.speaker: Drake
dialogue.text: Then we show him another path. We show him that what he fears can be faced.

scenes.narration: The outer wall breaks. The remaining defenders scatter. Footsteps on stone — and then the second four arrive at the junction deep in the fortress, breathing hard, alive.

dialogue.speaker: Tao
dialogue.text: We are alive. Noted. Everyone accounted for?

dialogue.speaker: Drake
dialogue.text: We held the inner corridor. You are late.

dialogue.speaker: Tao
dialogue.text: We were being dramatic. It takes time.

scenes.narration: Rei looks down the passage ahead. The air beyond the junction is different — older. The darkness here is not Valdris's design. It is what was here before him.

dialogue.speaker: Rei
dialogue.text: Beyond this point is not his fortress. It is where the Shadow Keepers chose to stand. Six hundred years of refusal made into stone and shadow.

dialogue.speaker: Ria
dialogue.text: The eidolons know this place. They have been trying to reach it since we crossed the threshold.

dialogue.speaker: Valka
dialogue.text: Maren the Still. And all those who stood with them. They did not die here. They became here. What we face is not a monster — it is a will that has not broken in six centuries.

dialogue.speaker: Lulu
dialogue.text: They have been waiting a long time.

dialogue.speaker: Rei
dialogue.text: They have been waiting for someone strong enough to end the waiting. That is us. Now. Together.

chapters.title: The Fortress Ramparts
chapters.map_hint: Fight through the Fortress Ramparts — the Shadow Titan waits at the inner core.

pre_dialogue.speaker: narrator
pre_dialogue.text: The fortress ramparts pulse like arteries — corrupted creatures emerging from every shadow, things that were once guardians now twisted beyond recognition.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Lulu
pre_dialogue.text: They were sentient once. Let us free them from this torment.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Valka
pre_dialogue.text: I have walked between worlds for millennia. This darkness is not evil — it is grief. Infinite grief. We cut through it.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Drake
pre_dialogue.text: Then we show it another path. We show it that what it fears can be faced.

post_dialogue.speaker: narrator
post_dialogue.text: At the core of the fortress, a scholar's chamber — ancient texts, constellations mapped on walls. And in the center, a mirror.

post_dialogue.speaker: Tao
post_dialogue.text: He was a scholar once. Curious about death. And when he could not escape it, he tried to escape life instead.

post_dialogue.speaker: Rei
post_dialogue.text: Then the darkness rises. Not Valdris himself — something he became. Vast. Immense. A titan of shadow.

post_dialogue.speaker: Aya
post_dialogue.text: This is not him. This is what he became when he refused to let go. We break it. And free what remains.

pre_dialogue.speaker: narrator
pre_dialogue.text: The darkness coalesces into something immense — a titan of shadow and will, wearing Valdris's grief like armour. Not a monster. A decision made six hundred years ago and never unmade.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Rei
pre_dialogue.text: Maren the Still. I know what you chose. I know why you stayed.

pre_dialogue.speaker: narrator
pre_dialogue.text: The titan turns toward Rei. Something in its form shifts — not aggression. Something older than aggression.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Rei
pre_dialogue.text: You chose to become the seal. Not because you were ordered to. Because it was the only way to hold, and you were the strongest. I understand that logic. I lived by it for two thousand years. It is not wrong. But it is over now.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Aya
pre_dialogue.text: This is not him. This is what he became when he refused to let go. We break it. We free what remains.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Valka
pre_dialogue.text: Six centuries of will. We honour it by ending it. That is the last gift we can give them.

pre_dialogue.speaker: Tao
pre_dialogue.text: For Maren. For all the Shadow Keepers who chose to remain. Let us end the waiting.

post_dialogue.speaker: narrator
post_dialogue.text: The titan staggers, cracks appearing in its shadow-form. But it does not fall — instead, it dissolves into cold mist, withdrawing into the very heart of the fortress.

post_dialogue.speaker: Tao
post_dialogue.text: It is weakening. We wounded something that thought itself invulnerable. The path to the Eternal Void is open.

post_dialogue.speaker: Rex
post_dialogue.text: I have ruled for ages, but I have never seen a stand like this. The Shadow Emperor is retreating because he finally has something to fear.

post_dialogue.speaker: Aya
post_dialogue.text: Then we do not give him time to recover. This is the end of his eternity. Move!
